profile.name: El Mahdi Bellaziz
profile.title: Software & DevSecOps Engineer
profile.tagline: I build secure, scalable full-stack applications and design DevSecOps pipelines that catch vulnerabilities before they ship.
profile.bio:
I'm a Full-Stack Developer based in Safi, Morocco, specializing in DevSecOps, cloud security, and Infrastructure as Code. I'm currently pursuing a State Engineer degree in Intelligent Networks & Cybersecurity at ENSA Khouribga.

 I have hands-on experience building secure CI/CD pipelines, implementing DevSecOps security tools, Kubernetes/GitOps deployments, and security automation with Python and AI. As a freelance developer, I also build secure web applications and business automation solutions using Laravel, Vue.js, and Nuxt.js, with experience integrating payment, identity verification, and business APIs.

experiences.description: Designed a secure CI/CD pipeline on GitLab CI (Oracle ARM runner) with automated code analysis, IaC checks, and signed SBOM generation, plus an ASPM platform with AI-assisted vulnerability triage.
highlights: Designed a secure CI/CD pipeline on GitLab CI (Oracle ARM runner) with code analysis (Gitleaks, Trivy, Semgrep), IaC checks (Checkov), and signed SBOM generation (Syft, Cosign)
Built an ASPM platform in Python to centralize and prioritize security findings using the FIRST/CVSS framework
Implemented an AI triage layer (Python agent + local LLM Ollama Qwen2.5 7B) to classify vulnerabilities (P1–P4) and cut false positives, with real-time Slack alerts
Deployed a security gate blocking critical vulnerabilities, with GitOps sync (ArgoCD) to Kubernetes and DORA metrics tracking via Grafana

experiences.description: Built complete web applications for international clients based in Europe: online administrative procedure management and business process automation, with secure authentication and electronic invoicing.
highlights: Secure authentication, personalized dashboards, and electronic invoicing compliant with the PEPPOL standard
Integrated third-party APIs (payment, identity verification, business registries) with Laravel, Vue.js, and Nuxt.js
Deployed and maintained production applications for clients based in Europe
